existing_qif_implementation.details: No QIF XML schemas, parsers, or exporters currently exist in src/engine/.

existing_xml_schemas.details: No QIF 3.0 ISO 23952 / ANSI QIF 3.0 XML schema definitions or XML serialization logic exist in the repository.

existing_qif_parser_exporter.details: No dedicated QIF 3.0 Part/Product/Results parser or exporter exists.

existing_pmi_model.details: Defines dimensions, datums, GD&T, and surface finishes for AP242, but lacks direct QIF 3.0 XML mappings.

existing_gdt_model.details: Supports POSITION, FLATNESS, PERPENDICULARITY, CONCENTRICITY with MMC/RFS and datum reference frames.

existing_tolerance_model.details: Handles symmetric, bilateral, and limits tolerances for manufacturing specifications.

existing_measurement_model.details: Implements touchpoint coordinates, deviation calculations, and measurement records.

existing_inspection_model.details: Generates inspection plans from AP242 models with geometry reference association hashes.

existing_metrology_model.details: Models ZEISS CMM probes, laser trackers, digital micrometers, and optical comparators with calibration records.

existing_feature_identity_system.details: Provides persistent topological naming across geometric feature modeling operations.

existing_persistent_topology_identity.details: Assigns deterministic persistent UUIDs and hashes to vertices, edges, loops, faces, shells, and solids.

existing_revision_system.details: Tracks design authority revision transitions (REV-A, REV-B) and prevents stale revision overrides.

existing_provenance_system.details: Maintains immutable acyclic graph of engineering decisions, operations, and signatures.

existing_evidence_system.details: Generates cryptographic evidence chains for inspection twins and measurement sessions.

existing_uncertainty_model.details: Calculates expanded measurement uncertainty (instrument + environmental) and applies strict guard-banding.

existing_quality_verdict_engine.details: Evaluates PASS, OUT_OF_TOLERANCE, INDETERMINATE, CALIBRATION_FAILURE, and MEASUREMENT_INVALID verdicts.

existing_manufacturing_feedback_path.details: Defines ClosedLoopRecommendation for tool offsets and CAD regeneration, but lacks formal QIF closed-loop revision proposals.

existing_canonical_engineering_document.details: Single canonical root for parametric feature trees, B-Rep solids, and PMI specifications.

existing_ap242_canonical_mappings.details: Bidirectional mapping between AP242 STEP Part 21 entities and SECP B-Rep solids/PMI.

existing_step_identity_mappings.details: Maps STEP entity #IDs to persistent topological IDs.
